text: SOLUTION (a) Any value of b with b > 16 is acceptable. (b) You use a trig substitution involving tan(u) when 2 + 8z + b does not factor; i.e, when 2 + 8z + b = 0 has no solutions. To determine when this happens, first complete the square, so 22 + 8z + b = 0 becomes (z + 4)? + b — 16 = 0 hence (z + 4)? = 16 — b. The solutions are z+4=2v16 — b, so z = —4 + /16 — b. There are two different solutions when 16 — b > 0, hence you need to use partial fractions when b < 16. There is exactly one solution when 16 — b = 0, namely = —4. There are no solutions exactly when 16 — b < 0, since then 1/16 — b is not defined. So the answer to be entered is 16 < b; i.e, (16, in finity).
